selection: These repositories are absent from previous external-tests. Inspect history before running the analyzer. Include all eligible candidates; do not select by analyzer results. Target 7 implementations and 2-4 real historical before/after pairs where small source and reproducible evidence exist. Log exclusions and substitutions before analysis.
size_limit: 600 physical source lines per implementation, excluding documentation/tests; copied source dependencies recorded separately
labels: PASS means the selected independently specified behavior passed, never whole-program correctness. BUG requires an upstream patch/test or a runtime witness against a written documented expectation. Unspecified behavior is observation only. No researcher-injected mutants in the primary set.
execution: Freeze source versions, test expectations, and classification before analyzer scans. Run runtime witnesses first. Preserve all failures. Do not modify tool rules. Dependencies copied at pinned revisions; no new tool dependencies or npm installation.
reporting: Report misses, false alerts, unsupported mechanisms and ambiguous results. Historical before/after versions are correlated; do not count them as independent implementations. Convenience sample, not blinded random evaluation or estimated general accuracy.
